readingMode: All 68 pages sequentially read: complete introduction, fourteen chapters and final continuation. Cover and page 15 inspected visually. Supplied excerpts preserve native whitespace.

coverage.authoredAnalysis: Cover visually read: BNG, Programa Electoral, Eleccións Xerais 2023, Que Galiza Conte / Con Máis Forza. Primary catalogue separates 2023 general from municipal and 2024 editions.

Complete contents: introduction and fourteen chapters, sovereignty/social rights/feminism/LGBT/democracy/public services/economy/energy/infrastructure/environment/language/youth/sport/peace; all included in reading.
Introduction: seek decisive Galician group, 2019 representation/investiture agreement and AP9 discounts/Burgo regeneration. Party achievement and electoral claims not independent evidence.

Completes railway/shipbuilding claims, Alcoa/fishing amendments; alleged outstanding courts/dependency/returnee tax/industry/rail/AP9 agreement breaches. Historical performance not numeric policy inference.
Criticises Western Sahara/energy/military/borders/labour/pension/security policy; temporary bank/energy/wealth taxes and price controls described as achievements, not proof of every rent-cap clause.
Minimum wages/pensions 60% average wage, public services/dependency/Galician/military-resource shift and opposition-party context. Claims of legal shortcomings not independently adjudicated.
Continues rival-party criticism; 57-law voting record and triple commitment to Galicia/social policy/opposition to right. Do not convert voting history to programme values.
Completes strategic electoral rationale: stronger Congress/Senate group and faster Galician agenda; no guaranteed consequence or voting instruction in quiz.
Sovereignty chapter: wind/thermal/energy/centralism criticism, inadequate administrative autonomy. Economic causal assertions are attributed to party.
Self-determination exercised through own constituent process toward sovereign Galician Republic; tactical State-competence improvements alongside sovereignty strategy.
Bilateral concert funding/Galician treasury collecting all taxes, labour competence/basic inclusion income/Social Security/pensions and public/judicial/traffic police transfer.
Public strategic energy control/Galician tariff, transport/airports/air control, coasts/Miño-Sil/maritime rescue/oceanography, AP9/AP53 nationalisation, audiovisual/archives/sport competence.
SAREB assets located in Galicia to social-public housing stock; all remaining statutory transfers. No inheritance to other party/region.
Social-rights/pov­erty background; IMV transfer/Galician inclusion income, poverty programme, protection spending at least EU average and public social services.

Completes public services; personal assistance, 33% disability recognition on neurodegenerative diagnosis. Housing 250euros/person, protected land/free SAREB/IBI vacant-home surcharge/public asset retention/affordable occupancy. Original says arrendadoras; do not silently substitute tenants.

Rehabilitation and vulnerable access, shared-flat youth grants; repeal labour counterreforms; 45 days unfair-dismissal compensation, administrative collective-dismissal authorisation, backpay and agreed conditions. Sector/regional bargaining precedence, 35 hours weekly without salary reduction, minimum wage 60% average.

Public pay revaluation, Galician bargaining, abolish temporary agencies/chained subcontracting/false self-employment, SEPE unemployed coverage/safety/reduced dangerous-work hours. Pension background/minimum60%average wage.

Pension actual-CPI annual revaluation, ordinary retirement65/partial61, public budget/wealth tax support, worker-selected10yearcalculation, hardship coefficients/progressive real-income self-employed contributions; elderly demographic background.
Dependency State financing/debt claims, in-person administration without appointments; migrant human/social rights and regularisation facilitation begin.
Completes regularisation/international asylum rights, migration office staffing/antiracism, close CIEs and end deportations under human-rights protections.
Feminism: larger violence-pact funds adjusted for Galician dispersion/age/resources; gender perspective across public policy. No precise new national percentage.
Femicide/victim statute, forensic/police risk reports/Imelga, medium-risk aggressor geolocation, Istanbul consent-centred sexual law, compulsory professional training and named dedicated courts.

Digital gender violence; reject surrogacy legalisation including via other countries, trafficking victims rights, abolitionist prostitution measures pursue pimps/clients without criminalising women, exit support/medium-stay centres.
Single-parent family law, compensated care-hour reductions/income during leave and State free-nursery finance; media gender code as public-funding condition.
LGBT rights, legal/social depathologisation, nonbinary/trans minor/migrant gaps, residential care training/hate stats/trans job inclusion. Source health prevalence claims not independently certified.
Complete LGBT jobs/asylum, deny public subsidies/sanction rights-denying organisations, school equality professional/content/healthcare training and legal identity recognition for trans migrants.
Repeal security law with explicit rubber-bullet/hot-return bans/police-veracity privilege removal; abolish permanent reviewable prison/post-sentence supervision, prisoner return continues.

Galician prisoner transfer, aggravated public disorder/1977amnesty repeal, Franco assets/public media pluralism, restrict intrusive data-law provisions, secrets transparency and binding referendums including self-determination.

Revoke Concordat/Holy See agreements; Hare quota, Galicia electoral district, remove source 5% threshold, secret booths/no distributed ballots/equal media/seafarer vote. Symbol-insult repeal, tax-fraud disqualification/revolving doors. Do not replace 5% with Congress 3%.

Completes parliamentary incompatibilities; direct public service/negotiated-contract transparency/SME social-green criteria; remove peripheral State/transferred ministries/provincial deputations, municipal autonomy reforms.

Public universal/free services and education rationale; public education0-18, Galician laic/coeducational model, State-constitutional criticism. Source legal interpretations not independently verified.
Galician education/FP/arts/university laws and full competence; single public network universal0-18/compulsory3-18, free textbooks/material/extracurricular activities.

Curriculum/grants/teacher exclusive competence, staffing/removal replacement limits/democratic directors; progressive concert abolition, immediate noncompulsory/sex-segregating exclusions; religion outside curriculum/HolySee agreements renegotiation.
Education at least7%GDP, public university1.5%GDP reference, Galician higher-ed law/evaluation/research career, transfer UNED/UIMP/CSIC/university grants; healthcare rationale starts.

Health-system critique; funding at least EU per-person average with dispersion/age, Galician drug pricing, exclusively public ownership/funding/management/provision via Law15/97change, universal coverage law.

Universal healthcare; publicly funded orthopaedics/rehabilitation and dental/podiatry/optometry/occupational/speech services. End medicine copay, staffing/research/training transfer, more MIR/EIR/PIR places, early/partial clinical retirement and LOPS reform.

Sanitary biology/legal professions/classification/worker rights/rare-disease research; gender health research/clinicaltrialsexrepresentation/symptoms; prison-health transfer with staff/funds/debt compensation.
Completes prison transfer/resources; nursing assistants level3curriculum/classification and health biologists legal recognition. Source law numbers retained as unverified legal references.
IRPF progressive work/capital differentiation and bracket adjustment to Galician inflation, inverse deductions and travel exemption 0.19 to 0.30 euro/km; corporate taxable location begins.

Corporate taxation where Galicia operations, size progression and SME retained-profit reserve from 10% to 25%; strategic-cycle deductions. Superreduced essential/cultural VAT, permanent food/fish/hygiene/transport/efficiency cuts, energy VAT 5%, electricity excise 0.5%, tax continuation.

Complete permanent bank/energy/wealth taxes with lower exemptions/progression/Galician management; antifraud/no public contract or aid to shell-tax-haven firms/green behavioural taxation. Industry crisis background and reindustrialisation.
Industry regional investment/naval technology, repay aids for relocation, diversify public Navantia into civil construction/Galician board/navalPERTE, Alcoa continuity including public intervention.
Food-chain law objective producer-cost references, Galician PAC/ecoschemes/pasture, repeal/adapt/suspend soil-nutritionRD1051/2022forGalicia, short local cycles; direct fishing treaty negotiation.

Fishing-dependent designation, relative-stability/quota reform, artisanal TAC/quota exemption, fish VAT reduction, Galicia free of offshore wind/seabed mining, maritime competence/estuary restoration/unified inspection. Illness/vote/bargaining amendments continue.
Completes seafarer occupational illness/vote/agreements; State research funding3%GDP2030, evaluation corrections for parental/care/violence leave and stable research jobs.
Research career/wages, CSIC/IEO transfer, pre-2011 grant pension rights, research statute/bureaucracy/integrity/harassment measures. Recovery amounts for 2023-2026 are source expectations.
Galician PERTE co-management/direct recovery funds, economic/demographic weight plus historical deficit/dispersion/age/periphery; sector dialogue/environment oversight and simpler applications.

Energy transition away from fossil fuels; distributed near-consumption smaller public-controlled generation and lower transport toll Galician surplus tariff; recognised production-cost electricity remuneration begins.

Production-cost remuneration, energy competence including installations over 50MW; withdraw POEM and exclude offshore wind in Galicia. Restore public/environmental checks and review approved projects.

Environmental evaluation and diverse renewable mix; essential electric access beyond social bonus/no supply cuts, efficiency/fossil reduction/sharedselfconsumption, recover reservoir concessions to public Galician firm, electrointensive jobs/just-transition bids.
Energy storage/research centre, regular transition agreements/mining plan debt, maintain fracking/similar-technique prohibition. Environmental and health effects remain source rationale.
Transport competence/regional integration, public local rail in main cities, named line upgrades and Atlantic goods corridor.
Goods corridor and town railway crossing works, more frequencies/lower fares/regular-user discounts, finish AVE/Avril, transfer to public GALTRÉN and independent accident authority; roads rationale.
Transfer AP9/AP53 and abolish tolls, A54/A74/A76/Castro viaduct works and responsibility, motorcycle/cycle protection; airports transfer starts.
Integrated public airports and control towers, named State ports transfer/Morás opening, railway intermodality and TEN-T basic-network inclusion.
Environment public competence/precaution/climate/circular economy/polluter cost internalisation; coasts/marine/rescue/meteorology/research/ports/waters transfers and State law reform.
Environmental/public participation, protect30%importantland/waters2030, biodiversity funding/marine species/nativecycles/invasivealert/bycatch measures, marine strategy begins.

Estuary sanitation/marine pollution bases, revoke ENCE extension/regenerate Pontevedra. Inspect nuclear-waste dump, not nuclear-reactor closure. Coastal military land transfer, communal forests/eucalyptus invasive catalogue/cultivation limits, waste/composting.
Local composting/contaminated soils; motor-traffic reduction/Pontevedra mobility rather than restrictions by vehicle age/type for low-emission areas. Not opposition to all clean-air action.
Galician RTVE/Radio4/audiovisual aid/Portugal reciprocity, equal official languages and dubbing/subtitles especially children; Galician teaching outside Galicia and border education starts.
Border education/cultural finance/archives digitisation, Galician administration/toponymy, preferred judicial language and UNED study/exams.
Youth centralism/economic critique, stable equal training-contract wages/employment, Galicianeducation/grants/researcherreplacementlimit removal. No quantified youth wage beyond parity.

Return emigrated youth, voting at 16-17, Erasmus/Interrail transfer, 1% State budget youth funding, public housing priority/primary-sector aid/under-30 travel discounts. Paid formative internships, gambling advertising restrictions and bullying protocol.
Youth mental-health prevention/action with sufficient resources; no other policy on page.
Sport competence/Galicianinternationalteams/federationsultimateauthority, revise flag/banner sanctions, women equality and disabled/mobility accessible facilities.
Peace/sovereignty rationale; active neutrality in Ukraine and negotiated peace, cease arms delivery/increase humanitarian aid, annul 2% GDP military commitment for social budgets.

Complete military social-budget shift, no arms to specified oppressive/aggressive regimes and parliamentary oversight. Withdraw occupation/aggression missions, Sahrawi referendum/Palestine recognition, Latin America/Cuba/Venezuela, NATO exit/dissolution, rights-based trade and asylum.
Migration social/labour/development protections, renegotiate Schengen for new migration policies, reject rights-restricting antiterror changes. Printed page 68 completes document; no annex follows.
